en.headline: Police arrest taxi driver for demanding five times the fare to The Peak
en.dek: Undercover officers were quoted HK$350 for a short Central-to-Peak ride that should cost about HK$66; the 69-year-old faces four charges including overcharging.
body: Police arrested a 69-year-old taxi driver late on Saturday after he allegedly demanded HK$350 for a short journey from the Peak Tram Central terminus to the Peak public transport interchange, roughly five times the normal metered fare of about HK$66.

Central District officers and Island Traffic personnel carried out an undercover operation against illegal taxi practices in the Central area. Officers posing as passengers boarded the taxi and were quoted the inflated price. The driver was arrested on suspicion of overcharging, failing to display his taxi driver identity plate, not setting the meter to the recording position, and breaching regulations on taxi driver appearance.

The man, surnamed Chan, was detained for further inquiries. The taxi was also detained for mechanical checks after officers suspected a fault with its equipment. Police continue to target overcharging, especially around tourist spots such as the Peak Tram terminus.

zh.headline: 警放蛇拘索五倍車資的士司機 中環往山頂收350元
zh.dek: 喬裝乘客由山頂纜車中環總站往山頂，合理車資約66元，司機索價350元；69歲男子涉四罪被捕。
body: 警方昨晚在中區打擊的士違規行動中，以喬裝乘客方式拘捕一名69歲姓陳的士司機。人員由山頂纜車中環總站乘的士前往山頂公共運輸交匯處，合理車資約66元，惟司機索價350元，約為正常收費五倍。
中區警區及港島總區交通部人員其後表露身分，以涉嫌濫收車資、沒有展示的士司機證、沒有將的士計程錶指示器設定於記錄位置，以及違反有關的士司機儀容的規定，拘捕該名司機。他現正被扣留調查。
涉案的士因懷疑機件有問題亦被扣留作進一步檢驗。警方提醒市民如遇的士濫收車資，應記下車牌及詳情向警方舉報。
